A modern IPTV player. It loads the [iptv-org](https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv) public playlist and the [epgshare01](https://epgshare01.online/) TV guide by default.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Android** (phones, tablets, Android TV · Android 7.0+) | `LumenTV-<version>.apk` |

### Installing

- **Android**: download the APK on your device and open it. Allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or file manager when asked.
  On Android TV, sideload it with a file manager or `adb install`.

## What's new in 1.11.0

- **Android TV: a real TV guide grid.**
  - Channels run down the side and shows along a timeline, with half-hour marks and a line for the current time.
  - **Left/Right** moves through the day (up to 12 hours ahead) and **Up/Down** moves between channels.
  - The selected show is described at the top: title, time, how long is left and its description.
  - **OK** watches the channel and **holding OK** opens channel options.
  - The **filter button** shows All channels, Favorites, Recently watched, a category or a country.
- **Android TV: All channels** now has the same filter column as the channel list (All, Favorites, Recently watched, Category, Country) beside the grid of channels. Channel up/down in the player then moves through the list you browsed.
- **Phones: the bottom navigation hides while you search**, leaving more room for results and the keyboard.
- **Search suggestions** before you type (from 1.10.1).
